## Measurement record · #33034 · executive dashboard chart timing · 2026-11-14T15:52Z

⛔ Not a claim. Measurement only: no product file changed, no PR.

**Answer.** On a normal link the executive dashboard's last chart draws 2.3–3.6 s after navigation, and nothing on the dataset path takes more than 0.2 s. The 20–25 s reading from #32627 item 5 reproduces (25.6 s) only with a **cold browser cache on a slow link** (1 Mbps, 400 ms RTT). With a warm cache, the same link draws the last chart in 3.7 s. The slow step is not the query, the analytics resolve or the render. It is the Console's eager JavaScript closure downloading before the dashboard can ask for data: about 22 of the 25.6 s. The showcase control has the same shape and the same numbers, so this is not specific to HotCRM.

### Setup

- **HotCRM** `objectstack-ai/hotcrm` main `ac4dd3d` (v6.2.1), on its own published pin `@objectstack/*` 18.4.0 (Console included), `pnpm dev` (SQLite, 388 seed rows). Dashboard `executive_dashboard`, at `/_console/apps/app.objectstack.hotcrm/dashboard/executive_dashboard`.
- **Control:** showcase `showcase_ops_dashboard` (also 9 dataset widgets) on objectstack `origin/main` `d4fbb4db`, a local build of the showcase closure plus `pnpm console:build`, `pnpm dev --fresh` (138 seed rows). The local Console's eager closure is 105 chunks at 2,288,370 B gzip. The published 18.4.0 Console is 105 chunks at 2,286,732 B, so both apps load the same front end.
- **Machine:** cloud container, 4 vCPU Xeon 2.1 GHz, 15 GiB, Linux 6.18, Node 22.23.4, headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 (Playwright), viewport 1440×1000, signed in as the dev admin.
- **Links:** `none` = localhost. `broadband` = 20 Mbps down, 5 Mbps up, 40 ms RTT. `slow` = 1.5 Mbps, 0.75 Mbps, 300 ms. `slower` = 1 Mbps, 0.5 Mbps, 400 ms. The last three are simulated with CDP `Network.emulateNetworkConditions`.
- **Server-Timing:** every request carried the admin's `X-OS-Debug-Timing: 1`.
- **Cold and warm:** *server cold* is the first dashboard request after a restart. *Browser cold* is a new context with an empty HTTP cache. *Warm* is a reload in the same context. Assets are served `br` with `cache-control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable`.
- **Drawn:** a 20 ms DOM poll per widget card. A metric counts as drawn when it shows a number, a table when `tbody` has rows, and a chart when a recharts shape exists. Times are milliseconds from navigation start.

### 1 · Time to first and last widget (ms)

| Run | HotCRM first / last | HotCRM batch start · server total | Showcase first / last | Showcase batch start · server total |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| localhost · server cold · browser cold | 2909 / 3483 | 2400 · 157 | 2242 / 2797 | 1814 · 144 |
| localhost · server warm · browser cold | 2126 / 2775 | 1944 · 62 | 2420 / 3129 | 2277 · 76 |
| localhost · warm · run 1 / 2 / 3 | 2574 / 3204 · 2029 / 2633 · 1701 / 2276 | 2358 · 100 · 1669 · 71 · 1326 · 71 | 2191 / 2760 · 1921 / 2505 · 1623 / 2267 | 2072 · 77 · 1621 · 47 · 1288 · 60 |
| broadband · browser cold | 3042 / 3592 | 2878 · 57 | 3226 / 3848 | 2944 · 62 |
| broadband · warm | 2267 / 2853 | 1943 · 57 | 2145 / 2708 | 1768 · 69 |
| slow · browser cold | 17282 / **17892** | 16712 · 73 | 16975 / **17554** | 16533 · 64 |
| slow · warm | 2531 / 3204 | 2067 · 79 | 2542 / 3108 | 2093 · 64 |
| slower · browser cold | 25026 / **25610** | 24229 · 98 | not run | |
| slower · warm | 3141 / 3743 | 2426 · 81 | not run | |

The four metric tiles and the table draw together, 0.15–0.32 s after the batch answers. The four charts draw together, about 0.55–0.65 s after the tiles, in every run on both apps.

### 2 · Per chart dataset query: parallel or serial, server against transfer

- **One request, not a waterfall.** All nine widget queries go in ONE `POST /api/v1/analytics/dataset/query/batch?callerPackage=…`. The server answers them with concurrency 6 (`DATASET_QUERY_BATCH_CONCURRENCY`, `packages/rest/src/analytics-routes.ts`). HotCRM's Owner filter sends its options query (`dashboard_filter_options` over `sys_user`) as a separate single-door request in the same tick, in parallel with the batch.
- **Batch, browser timing.** TTFB 60–160 ms on localhost and broadband. Body 2,065 B, received in 18–30 ms. On the slow links TTFB is 336–479 ms: one RTT plus the server time.
- **Batch, Server-Timing.** Total 40–160 ms, cold first: 157 ms on HotCRM, 144 ms on showcase. `handler` is nearly all of it. `db` is 4–11 ms across 19–26 SQL statements.
- **Each query on its own,** replayed warm through the single door, median of 5, Server-Timing total:

| HotCRM widget query | server ms | db ms |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `opportunity_metrics` total_amount YTD + compareTo previousYear | 19.9 | 2.0 |
| `account_metrics` count | 9.7 | 1.4 |
| `contact_metrics` count | 12.7 | 2.0 |
| `lead_metrics` count | 9.2 | 1.3 |
| `opportunity_metrics` by close_date | 9.9 | 1.3 |
| `opportunity_metrics` by account_industry | 8.8 | 1.3 |
| `opportunity_metrics` by stage (pipeline) | 9.2 | 1.4 |
| `account_metrics` by created_at | 10.2 | 1.2 |
| `account_metrics` by industry (table) | 10.4 | 1.7 |

  The nine single answers add up to 99.9 ms. The batch takes 39–43 ms of server time (44–47 ms wall), and the nine sent in parallel as singles take 86–128 ms wall. The showcase singles take 9.3–16.7 ms each (103.9 ms together), its batch 26–40 ms.
- **Round trips before the batch.** The batch is the fifth serial wave of API calls. The order, measured on the warm slow link:
  1. `runtime/config` + `auth/get-session`
  2. after the JS runs: `auth/me/permissions`, `discovery`, `i18n/translations/en-US`, `auth/organization/get-active-member` + `list`
  3. `auth/config`, `meta/app`, `data/sys_user_preference`
  4. `meta/object?package=…`, `me/apps`, `meta/app/crm_enterprise/bundle`
  5. the batch and the filter-options query, sent about 240 ms after the app bundle answers

  `meta/view`, `meta/doc`, `meta/book`, `meta/object/sys_approval_request` and `packages` go out alongside wave 5 and do not hold it up. With a warm cache this sets a floor of five RTTs before data: about 2.0 s at 400 ms RTT, 1.5 s at 300 ms, 0.2 s at 40 ms.
- **Chart code.** `plugin-charts` and `vendor-charts` are lazy and outside the eager closure. They are requested only after the data arrives and are served from cache in 5–50 ms. That leaves about 0.55 s from tiles to charts, which is render time on this 4-vCPU headless box.

### 3 · The slow step: browser-cold transfer of the Console's eager closure

Timeline for HotCRM, slow link, browser cold (17.9 s):

- 0–0.36 s: the document. Then `index-*.js` (134 KB) arrives at 3.7 s and `vendor-objectstack-*.js` (599 KB) at 12.2 s.
- 2,294,348 B of scripts in total arrive before the second boot API call (`auth/me/localization`) goes out at 14.25 s.
- 14.25–16.71 s: API waves 2–4 above.
- 16.71–17.24 s: the batch, of which 73 ms is server time.
- 17.28 s: tiles and table drawn. 17.89 s: charts drawn.

The published Console's `dist/eager-closure.json` puts the eager closure at **105 chunks, 2,286,732 B gzip (7,710,567 B raw)**. The dashboard's own code (`DashboardView`, `plugin-dashboard`, the chart chunks) is lazy, outside the closure. The closure still carries code a dashboard route does not draw: `plugin-grid` (159 KB gz), `plugin-form` (44 KB), `PackageFormDialog` (44 KB), `RecordDetailView` (27 KB) and `i18n-ns-studio-en` (64 KB), next to `vendor-objectstack` (634 KB) and `ui-components` (327 KB). Asset names are content-hashed, so the browser is cold again after every release.

### What this does not cover

- These numbers come from a simulated link from this container, not a real remote one. The #32627 environment, which ran HotCRM 6.1.2, was not measured.
- The data volume is the seed (388 rows on SQLite), so server time on a large tenant may be higher. Even so, the batch would need to grow about 100× to show up next to the cold transfer.

Slow-step finding and two observations are in the os-dev-report below, for the seat.

## ACCEPT · #33034 · measurement delivered · 2026-11-14T15:56Z

- **Read against the card:** all three "Do" steps are answered in record 6880118403 (os-dev-report 6880126393, `pr: null`, a legal final report for a measurement card). (1) HotCRM executive dashboard plus the showcase control, server cold/warm, browser cold/warm, four links. (2) Per query: one batch request, not a waterfall; 40–160 ms server; each query 8.8–19.9 ms. (3) Slow step named: the Console's 2.29 MB gzip eager closure on a cold browser cache; not the query, analytics resolve or render.
- **The card's question:** on a normal link the last chart draws in 2.3–3.6 s. The 20–25 s of #32627 item 5 is a cold-cache, slow-link reading (reproduced at 25.6 s, 1 Mbps / 400 ms).
- **Filed:** #33293 (p3, `domain:ui`), the eager closure carrying grid / form / Studio code a dashboard route does not draw. The two observations (five serial boot waves; uncached `GET /api/v1/packages`) are recorded on #33293 and not filed.
- **Accepted deviation:** HotCRM ran on its published 18.4.0 pin, not the `main` build (hotcrm's own AGENTS.md forbids patching its runtime); the two eager closures match within 1.7 KB, and the showcase control ran on `main`.

Closing as completed: the measurement is the deliverable, and no fix was promised on this card.
